description: Hi! I'm a B.Tech Computer Science student interested in coding, software development, data analysis, and space exploration. I've selected the challenge “Be an Earth System Trend Detective!” and I'm excited to explore NASA's Earth science data and build an innovative solution. I'm looking for enthusiastic teammates with skills in Python,web development,UI/UX design,or research. Teamwork,creativity, and a willingness to learn are what matter most. Let's collaborate and create something meaningful!
